items.title: AI demand is 'exceptional,' but the supply chain is not: HPE CEO
items.summary: HPE (HPE) reported third quarter earnings results on Wednesday. HPE CEO Antonio Neri sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss the relationship between the roaring demand for AI and the industry's extreme supply-chain constraints.

items.title: How Nvidia's latest deal continues to target all points of the AI trade
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to report on Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face, the company's bet on open AI models, and now accounting for 8% of the S&P 500 market cap.

items.title: Why Nvidia's purchase of Hugging Face is an 'important strategic move'
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) will be buying open-weight AI company Hugging Face for $12.9 billion. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley and BD8 Capital Partners, LLC CEO Barbara Doran to discuss what this means for Nvidia's standing in the AI ecosystem as it aims to become more than just a chip supplier.
